The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: The Menologion of Basil II miniature for 3 January, categorised Saint Gordius, shows the Cappadocian martyr-centurion beheaded under Licinius - the same day, province and manner of death as the folder's Gordius of Caesarea. Commons describes it: Константинополь. 985 г. Миниатюра Минология Василия II.  Ватиканская библиотека. Рим.
